scenes.text: You are standing on a peaceful lake in Louisiana, enjoying the quiet morning, when suddenly an oil rig nearby starts tilting.
A tiny calculation error caused a drilling team to accidentally pierce a giant salt mine deep beneath the lake bed.
As the water rushed in and dissolved the salt, a massive whirlpool formed, swallowing eleven giant barges and sixty acres of land.
Unbelievably, everyone survived the chaos, but would you have panicked in this situation? Comment below and follow for more crazy history!
